image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) partially hiding within a rocky crevice. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior section. The background consists of purple and pinkish coral or rock structures.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish's head is angled away and partially obscured by shadow/rock; the mouth details are not visible.
The eye is clearly visible, large, and positioned correctly on the black head section.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows the correct high-backed, laterally compressed profile typical of angelfish/butterflyfish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinct black front and yellow rear coloration pattern is perfectly matched. The transition is sharp and accurate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin is largely occluded by the overhanging rock structure above the fish.
The anal fin is hidden in shadow or occluded by the angle and surrounding rocks.
The caudal peduncle and base of the tail are visible and appear consistent with the rounded tail morphology, though the full edge is slightly cut off.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the rocks in the lower foreground appears smeared and painterly, lacking the crisp granular detail expected in a macro underwater shot. It resembles AI-generated noise rather than natural sediment.

There is slight edge bleeding where the black head of the fish meets the dark shadow of the rock. While this could be low-light blur, the edges lack the sharp definition of a focused lens, suggesting minor generative softness.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'rock beauty' class. All testable checkpoints regarding coloration, body shape, and eye placement are passed. The specific black-and-yellow demarcation is accurate. Several anatomical checkpoints were untestable due to occlusion, but no contradictions were found in visible areas.
artifact_reasoning: The subject itself is structurally sound, but the environment exhibits AI artifacts. The foreground rocks have a muddy, inconsistent texture (severity 2.5), and there is minor edge softness between the fish and the dark background. These issues prevent a perfect artifact score despite the high quality of the main subject.
